biggest_catch: The friend must complete a two-stage gauntlet within 90 days: 10 debit card transactions plus opting out of paper statements, THEN 2 direct deposits of at least $100 - the referrer gets nothing if the friend stalls at stage one.
catches: Referrer: current NGFCU member 18+ in good standing; completes the referral form.

Friend must: open NGFCU savings AND checking accounts; complete 10 debit card transactions and opt out of paper statements within 90 days of opening; then complete 2 direct deposits of at least $100 each into savings or checking within the first 90 days.
Referrer earns $75 per qualified referral; referred applicant compensated up to $75 ($25 + $50).
Cap: $750 per calendar year to a single referrer (10 referrals).
Awards deposited into regular share savings accounts and subject to taxation.
Program can be changed or cancelled at any time.
